title: Maps
newDescription: The new map is added to this world. Tilesets and stamps are shared.
removeDescription: The map is deleted from the world. This cannot be undone.
removeScanning: Looking for portals that lead here…
removeNoPortals: No portals lead to this map.
removePortals: {count, plural, one {# linked portal} other {# linked portals}}: {levels}
removeUnreadable: {count, plural, one {# map} other {# maps}} could not be read; their portals were not counted.
removeLast: A world keeps at least one map.
pickHint: Opens the target map; click to choose the point
pickBanner: {level} — click a cell to choose the target point
pickSourceGone: The portal is gone; the point was not written.
pickOutside: Click a cell inside the map.
paletteOutOfRange: {level}: {count, plural, one {# tile is} other {# tiles are}} outside their tileset (the image may have shrunk). They show empty and are not exported.
paletteMissingTileset: {level}: uses tilesets that are not in the world ({ids}). Those tiles show empty.
